request.query: triangle inequality for the sum of absolute values of integer multivariate polynomial coefficients

items.name: AbsoluteValue.listSum_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_5} {S : Type u_6} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] [inst_2 : PartialOrder S]
  (abv : AbsoluteValue R S) [AddLeftMono S] (l : List R), abv l.sum ≤ (List.map (⇑abv) l).sum

items.name: Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_9} [inst : AddCommGroup G] [inst_1 : LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] (f : ι → G)
  (s : Finset ι), |∑ i ∈ s, f i| ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, |f i|

items.name: IsAbsoluteValue.abv_add
items.type:
∀ {S : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring S] [inst_1 : PartialOrder S] {R : Type u_6} [inst_2 : Semiring R] (abv : R → S)
  [IsAbsoluteValue abv] (x y : R), abv (x + y) ≤ abv x + abv y

items.name: Multiset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommGroup α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {s : Multiset α},
  |s.sum| ≤ (Multiset.map abs s).sum

items.name: nnnorm_sum_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E),
  ‖∑ a ∈ s, f a‖₊ ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, ‖f a‖₊

items.name: IsAbsoluteValue.abv_sum
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] [inst_2 : PartialOrder S]
  [IsOrderedRing S] (abv : R → S) [IsAbsoluteValue abv] (f : ι → R) (s : Finset ι),
  abv (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, abv (f i)
